name: Omar Alvarez
headline: Data Scientist
summary: Data scientist and software developer with a track record of turning messy operational data into reliable reporting and predictive features. Experienced in building practical pipelines, improving data quality, and partnering with stakeholders to deliver measurable results. Comfortable moving between scripting, analysis, and production-minded model work.
